post_clip.description: Sudden violent explosion at ~5.0s: bright flash, rapid expansion of dense smoke/dust cloud, people thrown backward and tables overturned—consistent with an instantaneous blast event in a restaurant setting.

A sudden violent physical altercation occurs: at ~16.5s, the person in the dark shirt lunges and tackles the person in the pink cap, causing both to fall to the floor behind the counter. This constitutes assault/violence—unprovoked physical attack resulting in one person being knocked down and subdued, with visible struggle and displacement of objects (e.g., cash register components scattered). No explosion or fire is present, but the abrupt, aggressive physical confrontation is highly abnormal and suspicious.
